question: The average age of 66(2)/(3)% of the number of children in a group is 13 years. The average age of all the children in the group is 14.5 years. What is the average age (in years) of the remaining children?
solution:
Given:

The average of the group is 66{2over3} %.

The average age of all groups is 14.5 years.

Formula used:

Average = (Sum of the observations) / (Number of observations)

Calculation:

The average of the group = 66{2over3}% = {200over3}×{1over100} = 2over3

The average of 2 children out of 3 is13.

So, The total age of 2 children = 13 × 2 = 26 years

And The total age of 3 children = 14.5 × 3 = 43.5 years

The average age of the remaining children = 43.5 – 26 = 17.5 years

**∴ Option 4 is correct.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

The average of the group = 66{2over3}% = 2over3 

⇒ x + 2 × 13 = 14.5 × 3

⇒ x + 26 = 43.5

⇒ x = 43.5 – 26 = 17.5

**∴ The average age of the remaining children is 17.5 years.**
